---
title: "How do I compare the means of two independent groups?"
---

## What the question asks

How do I compare the means of two independent groups?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Confirm the samples represent independent groups.

2. Examine plots and sample sizes.

3. Use t.test(groupA,groupB,var.equal=FALSE) and interpret the interval for mean difference.

## Runnable example

```{r}
group_a <- c(8,9,11,10,12,9,13,11)
group_b <- c(13,15,12,16,14,15,17,14)
result <- t.test(group_a,group_b,var.equal=FALSE)
print(result$estimate)
print(result$conf.int)
print(result$p.value)
```

## Interpret the result

The result estimates the difference in the two population means with a Welch confidence interval. It cannot establish why the groups differ.

## Check before using real data

The method is not appropriate for paired observations. Verify independence and examine distributions before interpreting the result.
